text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm! How can I make people feel that Feng 
Shui is more relatable?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A lot of folks still tell me it seems 
fishy, though. It really is a legitimate 
field of study with proper evidence, you 
know~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If we want to reach people who aren't 
interested yet, the quickest way is 
probably the mere-exposure effect, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, I'm gonna ask Air Groove-san 
if I can put a Bagua chart in the 
bathroom!
